title: eria jerdoniana
intro: Eria jerdoniana, commonly known as the 'Yellow Vanda', is a species of orchid native to the Western Ghats of India. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce stress, promote wound healing, and protect against oxidative damage. The therapeutic actions of Eria jerdoniana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, among others. The bioactive constituents in Eria jerdoniana contribute to its potential use in the treatment of various diseases, including diabetes, cardiovascular disorders, and certain types of cancer.
